title: EventBus multi-callback cross-mutation snapshot recovery contract

contract.multi_callback_cross_mutation: A callback can unregister and re-register multiple other owners during an active EventBus.emit() cycle
contract.snapshot_delivery: Every listener present at the start of the broadcast receives the active event exactly once
contract.current_cycle_reregister_isolation: Listeners re-registered during the active broadcast do not receive that broadcast a second time
contract.single_owner_entries: Each re-registered owner has exactly one listener entry
contract.registry_order_integrity: Removed and re-registered listeners are appended in mutation order
contract.duplicate_owner_prevention: Cross-callback mutations do not create duplicate owner entries
contract.post_recovery_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts deliver exactly once to every currently registered listener
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after multi-callback mutation
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
